Bill.BriefDescription: Changing the required seller's real estate disclosure of proximity to farming.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a seller's real estate disclosure of proximityto farming; and amending RCW 64.06.022.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 64.06.022 and 2005 c 511 s 3 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A seller of real property ((located within one mile of the propertyboundary of a farm or farm operation)) shall make available to thebuyer the following statement: "This notice is to inform ((prospectiveresidents)) you that the real property ((they)) you are ((about toacquire lies within one mile of the property boundary of a farm))considering for purchase may lie in close proximity to a farm. Theoperation of a farm ((may generate)) involves the usual and ((ordinarynoise, dust, odors, and other associated conditions, and thesepractices)) customary agricultural practices, which are protected((by)) under RCW 7.48.305, the Washington right to farm act."
